supersedes.immutability: v1 remains unchanged; this artifact does not rename, add, remove, or reorder its 20 categories.

canonical_primary_category_set.routing_question: 這篇來源未來主要幫我完成哪一種工作？

preconditions: All existing category include and exclude rules are demonstrably inapplicable.
The proposed category is not a single tool, company, event, or short-lived trend.
The proposed category can recur and produce durable work outcomes.
The proposal states its name, include rule, exclude rule, first source, and difference from every existing category.
required_artifacts: an owner-reviewable rationale and candidate source evidence
prohibitions: Do not create a live collection, route a post, or mutate a knowledge map from this governance decision.
Do not use a single source or a model label as sufficient justification.

legacy_collection_policy.preserve: Existing post relations remain historical context.
legacy_collection_policy.retirement: A later authorized phase may retire or hide legacy collections only after manifest and readback.
physical_delete_requires: zero post, map, scope, and workflow references

knowledge_map_policy.owner_gate_question: 這篇要延伸哪一個既有專案／知識地圖？還是要以它建立一張新的知識地圖？

phase_gate.phase_0: Documentation only. No DB, live collection, post, Vault, PM2, Cron, node, or relation mutation.
phase_gate.before_phase_4: Capture remains capture-only; no automatic source-folder selection is enabled.
phase_gate.phase_4_prerequisite: Docker and authorized live single-source validation must pass before runtime routing can be enabled.

owner_decision: The canonical 20 categories remain the primary set. Future expansion is allowed only through the governed version-and-decision-record process above.
